## Workflow
<!-- Which workflow (e.g. skf-create-skill, skf-test-skill) -->


## Step File
<!-- Exact path to the step file where the issue occurred -->
`src/skf-{workflow}/references/step-NN-name.md`

## Section
<!-- The heading of the section where the issue occurred, as a kebab-case slug (e.g. `missing-staging-path`). Never a line number. -->


## Severity
<!-- Pick one: `bug` | `friction` | `gap`
     bug      = instructions were wrong or contradictory
     friction = instructions worked but caused back-and-forth or guessing
     gap      = a scenario arose that wasn't covered at all -->


## Fingerprint
<!-- Deterministic dedup key: first 7 hex chars of sha1("severity|workflow|step_file|section-slug|defect-key"),
     each as this issue writes it in Severity, Workflow, Step File, Section and Defect Key.
     Auto-generated by the health-check workflow and also applied as an `fp-XXXXXXX` label.
     If you are filing this manually, compute it from those five fields and include it here AND as a label;
     the dedup Action will link your report to any existing canonical issue.
     The section fingerprint is the same hash without the defect key: write it here only, never as a label. -->
`fp-XXXXXXX`

Section fingerprint: `fp-XXXXXXX`


## Defect Key
<!-- One to four lower-case ASCII words joined by hyphens that name the thing the fix would change, in the step
     file's or the code's own words: the most specific function, script subcommand, field, flag or rule the fix
     would edit, split at underscores, dots and case changes, leading dashes dropped (`floor_check` gives
     `floor-check`). For a missing rule, name the case it should cover in two to four of the step file's words,
     never the section's subject alone. Never a line number, file name, severity or words from your session's story. -->


## Finding
<!-- ONE sentence. What is the problem? Do not explain why yet. -->


## Expected
<!-- ONE sentence. What did the step instruct or imply should happen? -->


## Actual
<!-- ONE sentence. What did you observe instead? -->


## Evidence
<!-- 2-5 bulleted `file:line` citations. Quote the exact text. No narrative. -->
- `path/to/file.md:NN` — "quoted text"
-

## Impact
<!-- ONE sentence. What did this cost in this session? -->
